summary: Lando Norris seized pole position in a rain-soaked scramble at Zandvoort, but George Russell's dominant sprint victory demonstrates Mercedes' pace heading into Sunday's main event at the Dutch circuit's final Formula 1 race. With Red Bull's Isack Hadjar sidelined by a wrist injury, McLaren faces an opportunity to capitalize on a depleted title competitor, though Russell's form suggests a three-way battle between Mercedes, McLaren, and Ferrari. A commanding performance from Norris or Russell this weekend could prove decisive in an increasingly tight championship fight, potentially reshaping the season's momentum at this historic goodbye to Zandvoort.
